goal: All calculations available in the referenced Steam97Web calculator must be covered before further capability expansion.

scope.include: All calculator tabs and available model/phase/input/units/domain variants, including features marked as requiring registration. Workflow parity tracked separately.
scope.external_applications: Linked spreadsheets, desktop/DLL/add-ins and other standalone sites are separate scope candidates; do not infer inclusion solely from an outbound link.

evidence.method: Official help and indexed public interface retrieved with web tools, plus current repository inspection.
evidence.interactive_reference: Blocked by executor proxy policy (CONNECT 403); no new live numerical cases or authenticated controls tested.
evidence.historical_comparison: docs/COMPARISON.md records one historical steam state; this is not a new full-site verification.

statuses.verified_rule: Exact input/model/phase/units/domain and required outputs enumerated; case results and tolerances with independent checks retained; user operation tested. Existing local tests alone do not close reference parity.
